patch_title: The Call of the Spear (1.10.0) Release Notes

changes.patch_title: The Call of the Spear (1.10.0) Release Notes
changes.change_text: Wand: Increased the amount of contribution gained from several abilities.

changes.patch_title: The Call of the Spear (1.10.0) Release Notes
changes.change_text: Flash Arrow: Flash Wave specialization: Removed the expanded area of damage granted by this specialization. Now only increases the effective range of healing granted to allies.

changes.patch_title: The Call of the Spear (1.10.0) Release Notes
changes.change_text: Devoted Shield: Added damage reduction effect.

changes.patch_title: The Call of the Spear (1.10.0) Release Notes
changes.change_text: Gaia Crash: Damage against monsters increased by 100%.

changes.patch_title: The Call of the Spear (1.10.0) Release Notes
changes.change_text: Infernal Meteor: Damage against monsters increased by 40%.

changes.patch_title: The Call of the Spear (1.10.0) Release Notes
changes.change_text: Icebound Tomb: Added the Freeze removal effect from specialization to the base ability functionality. Can now target the caster to apply the freeze removal to yourself.

changes.patch_title: The Call of the Spear (1.10.0) Release Notes
changes.change_text: Icebound Tomb: Ice Armor specialization: Replaces the previous Freeze removal specialization. Ice Armor now grants cooldown reduction to Icebound Tomb.

changes.patch_title: The Call of the Spear (1.10.0) Release Notes
changes.change_text: Serial Fire Bombs: Focused Fire Bombs specialization: Reduced the duration of the Recovery Effect debuff from 6 seconds to 3 seconds.

changes.patch_title: The Call of the Spear (1.10.0) Release Notes
changes.change_text: Ray of Disaster: Damage against monsters increased by 30%. Fixed an issue where Ray of Disaster VFX could remain on screen after the caster dies.
